venues.name: Kulttuurisauna
venues.description: Wood-fired public sauna at Hakaniemenranta in Helsinki, designed by architects Tuomas Toivonen and Nene Tsuboi, opened 2013. Two saunas (men's + women's), cold dip in the Baltic, no booking, eco-architecture.

venues.name: Seven Star Smoke Sauna at Isokenkäisten Klubi
venues.description:
The gentle warmth and scent of the Seven Star Smoke Sauna at Isokenkäisten Klubi in Kuusamo leaves you with an ever-lasting memory. 
The sauna is heated with dry birch logs that come from our own forest. Heating the smoke sauna is not a job for a busy man, it takes hours of careful heating to get the temperature right. Our sauna master takes care of heating the sauna, and he also knows how to make the traditional, fragrant birch whisks. Bathing in an authentic smoke sauna is a unique experience.

venues.name: Dudka Bar & Sauna
venues.description: A unique wood-fired sauna and bar on Ko Pha Ngan, Thailand. Wood stove-heated löyly with an ice bath for contrast therapy — authentic Finnish sauna culture meets tropical island life. One of the most unexpected and beloved sauna experiences in the world.

venues.name: Sauna Hermanni – Hakaniemenranta
venues.description: A cherished traditional public sauna in Helsinki's Hakaniemi district. Wood-heated löyly, authentic Finnish bathing culture, and a loyal local community. One of Helsinki's last remaining neighborhood public saunas.

venues.name: Vabali Spa Berlin
venues.description: Premium Balinese-inspired sauna and wellness complex near Berlin Hauptbahnhof. 10+ themed saunas, outdoor pools, relaxation gardens. One of Germany's best.

venues.name: Kusatsu Onsen
venues.description: Japan's #1 ranked onsen for 15 consecutive years. Famous yubatake (hot water field) in the town center. Strong sulfur-rich waters.

venues.name: Beppu Onsen
venues.description: Over 2,000 hot springs in one city — the most of any city in the world. Features mud baths, sand baths, steam baths, and medicinal baths.

venues.name: Avita Therme
venues.description: Die Therme Burgenland ►Wellness, Exklusivität und Lifestyle ✔Thermalwasser ✔Sauna ✔Day Spa ✔Naturbadeteich ✔Spa-Behandlungen ✔großer Außenbereich

venues.name: Jantsu talu suitsusaun ja kilesaun
venues.description: Suitsusaun on ehe osa Eesti pärandist – rahulik paik lõõgastumiseks, tervise turgutamiseks ja looduslähedaseks elamuseks. Tule ja koge suitsusauna väge!

venues.name: Dogo Onsen
venues.description: The oldest onsen in Japan, in continuous use since the 6th century. The 1894 Dogo Onsen Honkan is a Tangible Cultural Property and the inspiration for the bath house in Spirited Away.

venues.name: Hotel Jungbrunn
venues.description: The 3D sauna at Jungbrunn introduces an architectural rarity in sauna design: curved, biomorphic geometry expressed in innovatively produced solid Swiss pine. Featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

venues.name: Pokumaa suitsusaun
venues.description: Kõik mis puudutab ajalugu, hetkeolukorda ja muud vajalikku informatsiooni, on leitav just esilehe alamsakist.

venues.name: Honey Banya Olgino
venues.description: Seaside luxury banya built by international banya builder James Larkin. All-wooden lounge with open fire and panoramic windows. Ice massages and honey scrubs.

venues.name: Vabali Spa Düsseldorf
venues.description: Vabali Spa is a premium day spa and sauna complex offering a wide range of saunas, steam baths, and relaxation areas in a Balinese-inspired setting. Features multiple themed saunas, outdoor pools, and restaurant.

venues.name: Kurokawa Onsen
venues.description: Famously authentic mountain onsen town in the Aso highlands. The 28 ryokan share a rotenburo (outdoor-bath) ticket so visitors can sample three baths in a single day.

venues.name: Rangi Saun
venues.description: Tallinn's only traditional smoke sauna, built with contemporary Estonian design in Nõmme.

venues.name: Krasnopresnenskie Bani
venues.description: Built 1977-1980, won the Gosstroy State Prize. Sanduny's chief rival for best banya in Moscow. Two-storey redbrick modernist building.

venues.description: Renaissance bathing palace opened in 1877. A 17-step Roman-Irish bathing ritual in Baden-Baden.

venues.description: One of Tallinn's oldest public saunas, completed in 1928 in Kalamaja. Wood stove and steam saunas.

venues.description: Originally built for the penniless of Imperial Russia's capital — one of the first public bathhouses in St. Petersburg. Now renovated with luxury steam rooms.

venues.name: Caracalla Therme
venues.description: Historic thermal bath in Baden-Baden with Roman-Irish bathing tradition, multiple saunas, and mineral water pools.

venues.name: Hakuba Zekkei Sauna Rooftop
venues.description: Rooftop Finnish-style sauna atop Hakuba Highland Hotel with full panoramic view of the Northern Alps.

venues.description: Wir haben alles, was du zur Erholung brauchst. Buche deine Auszeit in der Steiermark und entdecke unsere drei Thermenbereiche in der Urlaubsregion Loipersdorf.

venues.name: Raua saun
venues.description: Traditional public sauna in central Tallinn.

venues.name: Rzhevskie Bani
venues.description: Originally opened 1888 near Rizhskiy Railway Station. One of Moscow's oldest continuously operating bathhouses with working-class heritage.

venues.name: Liquidrom
venues.description: Urban spa lounge in Kreuzberg with saltwater pool, underwater music, and multiple saunas. DJ sessions on weekends.

venues.name: Noboribetsu Onsen
venues.description: Hokkaido's most famous onsen with 9 types of thermal water. Jigokudani (Hell Valley) volcanic landscape.

venues.name: Therme Wien
venues.description: Ihre Auszeit vom Alltag in der Therme Wien. Genießen Sie Entspannung und Erholung in Wiens schönster Wellness-Oase.

venues.name: Sanduny Sibir
venues.description: The Siberian branch of legendary Moscow Sanduny, housed in a 1937 building (former City Bath No. 8). Known for unique soft aromatic steam.

venues.name: Adelindis Therme
venues.description: Die Thermen- und Saunalandschaft der Adelindis Therme hat geöffnet. Eine Voranmeldung ist nicht notwendig.

venues.name: Hakone Onsen

venues.name: Varshavskie Bani
venues.description: Thoroughly restored historic banya in Moscow's south. Traditional Russian bathing culture with modern facilities.

venues.name: Aqualon Therme
venues.description: Wohlfühlzeit genießen, Körper & Geist in Balance bringen. Therme, Sauna, Wellness & Fitness im Aqualon für Ihre aktive & passive Erholung.

venues.name: SAZAE
venues.description: Designed by Kengo Kuma & Associates with interiors by Japanese sauna collective TTNE; named after the sazae, a conical sea snail native to Japan. Part of Naoshima's contemporary art programme. Featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

venues.name: Zhivica Banya
venues.description: Handcrafted Karelian pine log cabin in central Moscow. Eight curated steam rituals including Altai Zhivica and Siberian spa programmes.

venues.name: Bodensee-Therme Konstanz
venues.description: Zeit für mich. Dem Alltag entfliehen, den Moment einfangen und gut zu sich selbst sein – darum geht es in der Bodensee-Therme Konstanz.

venues.name: From P Hakuba
venues.description: A glamping site combining a barrel sauna with dome tents (integrated stove systems) and outdoor structures for cooling and rest. Featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

venues.name: Dyröns Bastu
venues.description: Wood-fired sauna at the southern tip of the car-free island of Dyrön in the Bohuslän archipelago. Ten metres from the sea, views over Marstrand and Hake fjords, accessible by ferry from Tjörn. Twelve-person capacity. Ranked best west coast sauna in Sweden by Sauna Ice 2025.

venues.name: Carolus Thermen Bad Aachen
venues.description: Carolus Thermen Bad Aachen - Thermalbad, Saunawelt, Spa und Kulinarik

venues.name: JIKON SAUNA TOKYO
venues.description: Saunachelin 2025 #2. The urban sauna of the future with five saunas, three water baths, and theatrical steam performances.

venues.name: Chiemgau Thermen
venues.description: Wohltuendes Thermalwasser, belebende Saunagänge, exzellente Wellness- und Kosmetikbehandlungen und genussvolle Gaumenfreuden.

venues.name: SAUNA TOKYO AKASAKA
venues.description: Saunachelin 2025 #2. The urban sauna of the future with five saunas, three water baths, and theatrical steam performances.

venues.name: Yrjönkadun Uimahalli
venues.description: Helsinki's oldest public swimming hall, 1928, with men's and women's saunas adjoining the central pool. The most architecturally significant public sauna in Finland.

venues.name: Claudius-Therme
venues.description: Mitten im Kölner Rheinpark empfängt Sie mit Blick auf den Kölner Dom eines der schönsten Thermalbäder Europas: die Claudius Therme.

venues.name: TOTOPA
venues.description: Saunachelin 2025 #5. Tokyo's urban wellness escape in Meiji Park with multiple saunas and herbal infusion baths.

venues.name: Allas Sea Pool
venues.description: Helsinki's iconic floating sea pool and sauna complex in the harbor with city views.

venues.name: Mediterana GmbH & Co.KG
venues.description: 13 uniquely themed saunas, thermal pools, and Hamam rituals near Cologne.

venues.name: Yufuin Onsen
venues.description: Hot-spring resort town under Mt. Yufu in northern Kyushu. Known for design-led ryokan, contemporary art galleries, and morning mist photographs.

venues.name: Kotiharjun sauna
venues.description: Helsinki's last wood-heated public sauna, operating since 1928 in the Kallio district. A traditional Finnish sauna experience.

venues.name: Rajaportin sauna
venues.description: Finland's oldest public sauna still in use, established in 1906 in Tampere.

venues.name: Saunaravintola Kuuma
venues.description: A popular sauna restaurant in Tampere combining traditional sauna with urban vibes on the lakefront.

venues.name: Kaupinoja Sauna
venues.description:
The whole family can enjoy Kaupinoja sauna.

Kaupinoja sauna is practically open all the time, except on the second Tuesday of every month, when maintenance is carried out there. In our large sauna you will get quality steam, after which it is nice to take a dip in the refreshing lake water.

You can swim in Lake Näsijärvi both in summer and in winter. From the sauna, a path and stairs lead directly to the lake, so the passage is smooth.

Welcome to the hot steam!

venues.name: Mermaid Spa
venues.description: An authentic Russian banya in Coney Island, Brooklyn. Wood-fired sauna with traditional platza oak leaf treatments, cold plunge pools, and a full Russian spa experience. A New York City institution for banya culture.

venues.name: Loyly Nordic Spa

venues.name: Red Square Chicago Bath House
venues.description: Chicago's authentic Russian banya and restaurant in Wicker Park. Traditional steam sauna, cold plunge, and Russian cuisine. A neighborhood institution for banya culture.

venues.name: Russian Banya of Dallas
venues.description: An authentic Russian banya in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Features a 220°F steam room, traditional venik treatments, cold plunge, and a full Russian restaurant. Texas's premier banya experience.

venues.name: The Dome Sauna

venues.name: Wild Haus

venues.name: Othership Flatiron
venues.description: 9,550 sq ft breathwork and sauna experience in Manhattan's Flatiron District. Performance sauna and ice baths.

venues.name: Wi Spa
venues.description: 24-hour Korean-style jjimjilbang in LA with hot and cold baths, progressive sauna rooms, and rooftop terrace.

venues.name: Archimedes Banya
venues.description: Archimedes Banya is a Russian bathhouse on the shores of the San Francisco Bay. It is a place to meet with old friends, make new ones, or have a quiet time just to refresh and energize yourself.

venues.name: Amber Sauna Palanga
venues.description: World's first amber sauna built with three tonnes of Baltic amber. Treatments incorporate amber oil, powder, and stones.

venues.name: Banya
venues.description: A traditional bathhouse in Portsmouth, US. Features a steam bath.

venues.name: Banya Athens Thissio
venues.description: Athens premier sauna and wellness destination. Features an electric sauna with powerful loyly and ice bath for contrast therapy. Open daily from 10am, serving the Greek capitals growing sauna community.

venues.name: Banya No. 2 Richmond Hill
venues.description: Admission includes unlimited time until we close, unlimited self-serve teas, 3 towels, and 1 robe to use for your visit. Feel free to bring your own towels and robe if needed. Restaurant, bar, and any treatments, robes and towels are at an additional cost. We work on a first-come, first-serve basis.

venues.name: Bathhouse Williamsburg
venues.description: Discover thermal pools, cold plunge, saunas, & steam rooms. Indulge in a massage, a body scrub, or facial. Yoga classes and special peerformances and events occur weekly. Enjoy the perfect Spa Day at Brooklyn Bathhouse.

venues.name: Druskininkai Sauna Complex
venues.description: Over 19 themed saunas including herbal, salt, and infrared variants as part of Lithuania's most famous spa town.

venues.name: HAVN Saunas
venues.description: Floating sauna barge at Ship Point in Victoria's Inner Harbour, founded by Nick Van Buren and Kurtis Vallee — successor to the iconic Steam Mystic sailboat sauna featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

venues.name: Junggok-dong Siloam Sauna
venues.description: One of Seoul's most famous 24-hour jjimjilbangs. Traditional Korean bathhouse experience.

venues.name: Meza SPA
venues.description: Rustic log cabin pirts in a forest clearing on the Kurzeme coastline, 30 minutes from dramatic Baltic sea cliffs.

venues.name: Nimmo Bay Floating Sauna
venues.description: Positioned just above the tidal reach in BC's Great Bear Rainforest, the Nimmo Bay Floating Sauna is a wood-centred retreat at one of Canada's premier wilderness resorts. Featured in CN Traveller's 'World's Most Beautiful Saunas'.

venues.name: Perkunijos Pirtis
venues.description: Kaunas's most celebrated sauna with a large pirtis and a traditional smoke sauna. Professional sauna masters lead Lithuanian pirtis sessions.

venues.name: Pilaites Maluno Pirtys
venues.description: Three traditional bathhouses along the Sudervele stream near a restored 1923 windmill. Surrounded by forest, pond, and river.

venues.name: Pirts Rozeni
venues.description: Traditional rural pirts on the Vidzeme coastline led by certified pirts master with 22+ years experience. Rituals with besoms, honey, and clay.

venues.name: Pirts Skola Lielzemenes

venues.name: Riga Floating Sauna
venues.description: Floating sauna on the Daugava River with panoramic Riga skyline views. Essential oils, birch whisks, and river plunge.
